Hi Lena — thanks for sending these over and for the quick turnaround. A few items from procurement side before we finalize the onboarding: 

- Can you confirm the account type on the bank letter (checking vs savings) and the account holder name exactly as it should appear on the PO/GL?
- Please fill our short vendor onboarding form (link below) so we can link your vendor record to our purchasing system. It asks for tax classification and primary AP contact.
- For remittance: we prefer a CSV with a dedicated column for Redwood PO number (PO_REF) and a separate invoice_id column. Can HarborTech include an invoice_line_reference column if you have line-level matching?

Link: https://redwood.example.com/vendor-onboarding/form/harbortech

Ben — can you confirm if Finance requires micro-deposits for ACH activation or if a bank letter + W-9 is sufficient for a $0.50k invoice threshold? Marissa — looping you for vendor record creation once we have confirmation.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference
From: ben.carter@redwood-inference.com <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood-inference.com, marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@harbortech.com>
Date: 2028-04-16T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor banking docs and sample remittance file

Thanks Priyom — quick finance note: 

- For ACH enabled vendors we require EITHER (a) a bank letter with routing/account + voided check OR (b) successful micro-deposit verification. Bank letter + W-9 alone is acceptable for low-risk vendors but we prefer micro-deposits for net-30 suppliers.
- CSV remittance spec: required cols = [PO_REF, invoice_id, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), amount_cents, currency, supplier_reference, invoice_line_reference (optional)]. Please ensure PO_REF exactly matches our PO prefix (RW-####).
- Attached is a remittance CSV template we load into PayOps. If HarborTech can populate this template, it will speed up reconciliation.

Attachment: redwood_remit_template.csv

If HarborTech prefers micro-deposits, we will wait for Lena to confirm the two amounts (we will initiate tests).

Ben Carter
Finance — Payments, Redwood Inference
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@harbortech.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood-inference.com, ben.carter@redwood-inference.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2028-04-17T11:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor banking docs and sample remittance file

Hi all — thanks for the details. We can do the micro-deposit verification. HarborTech initiated two test ACH credits to the Redwood account this morning: $0.12 and $0.37 — please confirm the amounts once you see them and we'll mark the account verified on our side.

I[0m've also populated the remittance CSV to include PO_REF and invoice_line_reference (attached). The PO_REF uses the PO number you provided on the quote; if Redwood requires the RW- prefix we can add that on our side when sending remits.

Attachments: HarborTech_bank_letter.pdf (clean copy), remittance_sample.csv (HarborTech-populated)

Note: HarborTech will accept the PO_REF field as the primary matching key. Let me know if we need to switch to invoice_id matching instead.

Best,
Lena
From: priyom.das@redwood-inference.com <priyom.das@redwood-inference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@harbortech.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com, ben.carter@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2028-04-18T14:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor banking docs and sample remittance file

Great — thanks Lena. We saw the micro-deposit amounts $0.12 and $0.37 come through this afternoon and have confirmed the account on our side. Next steps: 

1) Marissa will create the vendor record and attach the W-9/bank letter.
2) HarborTech to start sending remittances using the attached remittance_sample.csv layout; include PO_REF with our RW- prefix (we'll accept either RW-1234 or 1234 but RW- preferred).
3) Priyom will send the vendor agreement (DocuSign) to Lena for signature; payments will start after the signed agreement and one cleared invoice cycle (expected within 5 business days).

DocuSign (vendor agreement): https://docusign.example.com/start/AG-4921
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/DT-8347

Marissa — feel free to proceed. Lena — welcome aboard, excited to get HarborTech in the payment cycle.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference
